name: Winterwandern am Sonnenterrasse Seefeld
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The Seefeld Plateau is perfect for winter hiking: over 200 kilometers of spacious winter trails wind through enchanting snowy landscapes. The route from the Wildsee to the Rosshütte offers breathtaking views of the Karwendel mountain range. Along the way, quaint huts invite you for a rest with delicious Tyrolean treats.
